name: Mira Joshi
about_me: I'm Mira, CEO and co-founder of Clearpath Meds, a medication adherence app for patients after discharge. Arjun Shah is my CTO. We need a clinical pilot site before we raise.
goals: Sign a hospital pilot site for Clearpath Meds

debriefs.text: Arjun Shah, my co-founder and CTO, said the app is pilot-ready and he wants to hire one more engineer.
Priyanka Desai, an angel who sold a telehealth company, offered to introduce me to a hospital contact.
Andre Williams, ED nurse, agreed to review our discharge workflow.
Talked to Esther Wu from Stryker business development. She said Stryker doesn't do pharma adherence but knows pharmacy directors.
Keisha Morrow at Maize Launch said healthtech teams can apply this cycle; deadline November 15.

request.need: A hospital or clinic willing to pilot a post-discharge medication app
request.about_line: CEO of a medication-adherence startup with a pilot-ready app
